Description
AppConfig
Singleton application configuration â€” lazy initialization variant, using double-checked locking so the instance is only built the first time AppConfig.getInstance() is actually called, and concurrent first-callers still only ever construct one instance.
Appointment
A booked slot between a Patient and a Doctor.
AppointmentNotFoundException
Thrown when an appointment lookup (cancel, complete, bill) is requested for an id that does not exist in the AppointmentService.
AppointmentObserver
Observer pattern: anything that wants to react to appointment lifecycle events (console reminders today; email/SMS notifiers could implement this the same way tomorrow) without AppointmentService needing to know about any specific notification channel.
AppointmentService
Create/view/cancel appointments.
AppointmentStatus
Lifecycle states of an Appointment, in place of magic strings.
Bill
Abstract base for a clinic bill.
BillFactory
Factory pattern: the single place that knows how to construct each concrete Bill subtype and stamp it with a generated id, so callers ask for a BillType instead of knowing which Bill subclass to new up themselves.
BillFactory.BillType
 
BillingService
Generates and stores bills, using BillFactory to construct the right Bill subtype and a BillingStrategy to work out what the patient actually owes after any discount/coverage.
BillingStrategy
Strategy pattern: how a bill's calculated total gets adjusted before payment (no discount, insurance coverage, ...) without BillingService branching on a payer type internally.
BillSummary
Immutable snapshot of a bill: every field is final, there are no setters, and the one mutable-looking piece of state (generatedAt) is fixed at construction time.
ConsoleReminderObserver
Concrete AppointmentObserver that just prints to the console â€” the simplest possible notification channel, standing in for a future email/SMS observer.
Constants
Application-wide constants.
ConsultationBill
Bill for a plain doctor consultation: base fee plus standard tax.
CSVUtil
Minimal CSV read/write helper.
DataStore<T>
Generic in-memory store keyed by each item's id, backing every service (doctors, patients, appointments, bills) instead of each one hand-rolling its own Map.
DateUtil
Formatting/parsing helpers around LocalDateTime, sharing one canonical pattern (Constants.DATE_TIME_FORMAT) so appointment timestamps display consistently everywhere.
Doctor
A clinic doctor.
DoctorService
CRUD + search over doctors.

Person
